name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [master, dev]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master, dev]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    name: Core and UI tests (iOS 27)
    runs-on: xcode-27
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: maxim-lobanov/setup-xcode@v1
        with:
          xcode-version: '27.0'
      - name: Boot available iOS 27 simulator
        run: |
          device_id=$(python3 .github/scripts/select-simulator.py)
          xcrun simctl bootstatus "$device_id" -b
          echo "IOS_SIMULATOR_ID=$device_id" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          mkdir -p artifacts
      - name: Core and real-engine tests
        working-directory: Packages/SwiftRadioCore
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          xcodebuild test -scheme SwiftRadioCore \
            -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,id=$IOS_SIMULATOR_ID" \
            -derivedDataPath "$RUNNER_TEMP/SwiftRadioCore" \
            -resultBundlePath "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/Core.xcresult" \
            -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile \
            -parallel-testing-enabled NO -collect-test-diagnostics never \
            -test-timeouts-enabled YES -maximum-test-execution-time-allowance 180 \
            -jobs 2 CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO 2>&1 | tee "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/core.log"
      - name: UI regression tests
        # Live radio availability is a separate integration check. All
        # remaining UI tests run; failures are retained rather than retried away.
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          xcodebuild test -project SwiftRadio.xcodeproj -scheme SwiftRadio \
            -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,id=$IOS_SIMULATOR_ID" \
            -derivedDataPath "$RUNNER_TEMP/SwiftRadioUI" \
            -resultBundlePath "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/UI.xcresult" \
            -skip-testing:SwiftRadioUITests/SwiftRadioUITests/testPopupNavigationAndRefresh \
            -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile \
            -parallel-testing-enabled NO -collect-test-diagnostics never \
            -test-timeouts-enabled YES -default-test-execution-time-allowance 120 \
            -maximum-test-execution-time-allowance 180 \
            -jobs 2 CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO 2>&1 | tee artifacts/ui.log
      - name: Retain test results and screenshots
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results-ios27
          path: artifacts/
          retention-days: 14

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
